crossRefs.note: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.
Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver…
Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved…

translations.web: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.
translations.bsb: Do not spend your strength on women or your vigor on those who ruin kings.
translations.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
translations.asv: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
